experiment.title: Agentic architecture search on the Gosai 2024 episomal MPRA (K562, HepG2, SK-N-SH)
experiment.summary: An evoloop search with Claude Opus agents for single models that predict episomal MPRA activity in three cell lines from 200-bp sequences, trained on a fixed 40% of the training chromosomes and selected by validation R2; the top 20 retrained on 100%, with MPRA-LegNet, Malinois and AlphaGenome as baselines.

objective.goal: Improve a sequence-to-activity model that predicts episomal MPRA log2 fold change jointly in K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH from 200-bp sequences (Gosai et al. 2024), trained on a fixed random 40% of the training chromosomes, starting from MPRA-LegNet.

data.input: 200-bp DNA insert (a few shorter, down to 73 bp) in a 400-bp window of real plasmid sequence
data.output: log2 fold change (RNA/DNA) in K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH, with standard errors

preprocessing.how: Rows of Table S2 used as published (no filtering by standard error or outliers). Each insert is stored as a 400-bp window centred in the real plasmid sequence that flanks it in the assay (boda2 MPRA_UPSTREAM / MPRA_DOWNSTREAM), coded A0 C1 G2 T3; labels are the published log2 fold changes and their standard errors for K562, HepG2, SK-N-SH.
preprocessing.code:
"""Build the fixed data files for the Gosai 3-cell-type search.

Split by chromosome as Malinois: test chr7, chr13; validation chr19, chr21, chrX; train the rest.
The train split is subsampled to a fixed random 40% of rows (seed 0). Validation and test are kept whole.
Each sequence is stored as a 400-bp window: the insert centred in the real plasmid flanks, coded
A=0 C=1 G=2 T=3, so a model may take any context up to 100 bp each side and shift within it.
"""
import argparse, re
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

WINDOW = 400
CELLS = ["K562", "HepG2", "SKNSH"]


def read_flanks(path):
    d = dict(l.split() for l in Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if l and not l.startswith("#"))
    return d["upstream_300"], d["downstream_300"]


def encode(seqs, up, down):
    lut = np.full(256, 255, np.uint8)
    for i, b in enumerate(b"ACGT"):
        lut[b] = i
    out = np.empty((len(seqs), WINDOW), np.uint8)
    lens = np.empty(len(seqs), np.int16)
    for i, s in enumerate(seqs):
        a = (WINDOW - len(s)) // 2
        w = up[len(up) - a:] + s + down[:WINDOW - len(s) - a]
        out[i] = lut[np.frombuffer(w.encode(), np.uint8)]
        lens[i] = len(s)
    assert (out < 4).all()
    return out, lens


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--table", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--flanks", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--train-frac", type=float, default=0.4)
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    up, down = read_flanks(a.flanks)
    df = pd.read_csv(a.table, sep="\t", dtype={"chr": str, "OL": str}, low_memory=False)
    split = np.where(df.chr.isin(["7", "13"]), "test", np.where(df.chr.isin(["19", "21", "X"]), "val", "train"))
    out = Path(a.out); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(a.seed)
    for name in ["train", "val", "test"]:
        idx = np.flatnonzero(split == name)
        if name == "train":
            idx = np.sort(rng.choice(idx, size=int(round(a.train_frac * len(idx))), replace=False))
        sub = df.iloc[idx]
        x, lens = encode(sub.sequence.tolist(), up, down)
        parts = sub.IDs.str.split(":")
        np.savez(out / f"{name}.npz", x=x, insert_len=lens,
                 y=sub[[f"{c}_log2FC" for c in CELLS]].to_numpy(np.float32),
                 se=sub[[f"{c}_lfcSE" for c in CELLS]].to_numpy(np.float32),
                 ids=sub.IDs.to_numpy(str), chrom=sub.chr.to_numpy(str),
                 project=sub.data_project.to_numpy(str),
                 variant_key=parts.str[:4].str.join(":").to_numpy(str),
                 allele=parts.str[4].fillna("NA").to_numpy(str),
                 source_row=idx)
        print(name, len(idx), x.shape)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

evaluation.test_policy: Test chromosomes (chr7, chr13) scored once per run with the best-validation weights; never shown to the agents.
evaluation.noise_floor_method: the value given for it (objective.noise_floor, from the brief's evaluation.noise or smallest_gain, or from evolve.yaml)

metrics.r2_mean: mean over the three cell types of 1 - SSE/SST
metrics.pearson_mean: mean over the three cell types of Pearson r

mse_mean.definition: mean over the three cell types of the mean squared error

metrics.r2_<cell>, pearson_<cell>, mse_<cell>: the same for one cell type

evaluation.prediction: every metric uses the average of the prediction for the window and for its reverse complement

rebuild_test.how: Exported with cameo.py export-run; the 40% split rebuilt from DATA-Table_S2__MPRA_dataset.txt (Zenodo md5 a1b36bb5e270b6414e74f2a83ea47e5d) with the stored split code (byte-identical to the search's files); trained with the stored train.py via run_full.py, seed 0, RTX A4000, 2026-11-23. Same best epoch (47) and epochs run (57); test R2 0.74097 as recorded.

environment.baselines: Malinois and AlphaGenome runs: PyTorch 2.7.1+cu118, Python 3.12, alphagenome-pytorch 0.3.2.dev98, alphagenome-encoder-ft 1.0.0

inference_hardware.passes: both strands of each sequence (two forward passes, averaged) as the models predict; median of 5 rounds of 10 batches, timed interleaved with MPRA-LegNet on the same GPU; examples_per_s = speed ratio to MPRA-LegNet x 17,970 (LegNet's median rate)

search.method: evoloop, profile harness: language-model agents propose new model structures and edits of settings, and code schedules, trains and scores every candidate; each generation is divided by kind of move (style balanced). Roles in use: explorer, exploiter, analyst, auditor.

findings.statement: AdamW weight decay 0.04 is near the optimum across trunk sizes. Raising 0.02 to 0.04 helped four LegNet lineages (C19 +1.34, C38 +1.54, C26 +0.85, C30 +0.38). Going to 0.08 cost 2.83 floors on the 1M LegNet (C80) and 2.71 on the 10M HRNet (C291).

PC-rotated targets with pc_temper 0.5 help or are neutral across trunks. They gave +1.0 on the LegNet branch model (C159), +1.35 on the pair-delta LegNet (C172) and +0.77 on the dilated HL-aux model (C155), with earlier results from -0.41 to +0.92 (C62, C66, C111, C169). Full whitening (pc_temper 1.0) costs: -0.64 (C69), -1.23 (C142).

open_questions: Does per-output specialisation earlier in HRNet add, given that both FiLM-around-final_ex variants (C243, C250) trailed by about 0.01 at epoch 50 and were cut?
Is C233's +1.02 from the fine-stream FiLM a real effect? The direct test (C251, C221 plus sh_film) was cut at epoch 53 at 0.8293, and re-adding it on C254 (C283) scored -0.64.
Does including per-row se in the Student-t variance matter outside HRNet, given that on HRNet scale 1.0 beat both 0.0 (C258, -1.76) and 2.0 (C269, -0.67)?
Is the 10M HRNet leader under-regularised by settings tuned on the 1M LegNet (weight decay 0.04, shift ±10)?
Is C290's gain from replacing the rotated-space MSE with the per-cell R²-space MSE real? Does it depend on replacing rather than adding, given that C298's additive form cost 0.72?
Does a heavier weight on the R²-space auxiliary MSE help C290, now that this term matches the score?

models.hypothesis: The three cell types share most of their signal but differ in a smaller specific part. A shared convolutional trunk with independent per-cell-type dense branches can model that specific part better than a single shared head. A flattened, position-aware representation may also capture positional motif effects that global average pooling discards.
models.change_summary: New model block only: Basset trunk (300x19, 200x11, 200x7 convs with BN and max-pool), adaptive max-pool to 8, shared Linear to 1000, then three per-cell-type branches (1000-140-140-1). All other blocks and the settings are kept from C7.

models.name: floored inverse-variance MSE

x.kind: one-hot DNA (A, C, G, T channels): the 200-bp insert in its real plasmid flanks, from make_batch

y.kind: log2 fold change (RNA/DNA) in K562, HepG2, SK-N-SH

models.hypothesis: The labels carry heteroscedastic measurement noise (se median 0.15-0.21, with a long tail of noisy rows). Weighting each cell type's squared error by 1/(se^2 + floor), with floor 0.05, clipped to at most 5x the mean and normalised to mean 1, lowers the gradient noise from badly measured rows and improves the fit to the reproducible signal. The largest effect should be in SK-N-SH, which is the noisiest cell type.
models.change_summary: Only data_handling and loss change: per-cell floored inverse-variance weights are packed into target columns 3-5 and used by a weighted MSE. Model, input_pipeline, optimizer and fit_params are kept from leader C7.

models.hypothesis: After local motif detection by convolutions, self-attention over about 60 downsampled positions can model motif-pair interactions and their spacing across the whole 240-bp window. The baseline's stacked 9-wide convolutions with pooling capture these only indirectly, so attention could lift the cell-type-specific part of the signal.
models.change_summary: New model block only: conv stem plus 2 LegNet EffBlock stages (pool x4 to 60 tokens), 4 pre-LN transformer layers (d=192, 8 heads) with learned position embeddings and layer-scale, mean pooling and MLP head. All other blocks and settings are kept from the leader C7.

models.hypothesis: For training rows whose other allele (same variant_key and tag) is also in the training set, explicitly fitting the predicted allelic difference to the measured one sharpens the model's sensitivity to single-base changes without changing what it learns about overall activity.
models.change_summary: Kept the model and settings from C7. data_handling builds a ref/alt partner index (keyed by chr:pos:ref:alt plus tag) and packs targets as [y(3), partner delta(3), has_partner]. make_batch (train only) appends partner rows with the same shift and flip. loss adds pair_weight (PARAMS.get, default 1.0) times the MSE of predicted versus measured allelic difference. [repair 1: Partner sequences now come in as 4 extra input channels instead of extra batch rows. The model always returns (B, 3), runs the one LegNet on the partner rows that are present, and leaves their predictions in torch._evoloop_pair_pred for the loss.]

"""MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), with one output per cell type."""
import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class DilBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, dil, ks=3, dropout=0.1, ls_init=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=dil * (ks - 1) // 2, dilation=dil, bias=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, 1, bias=False)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.scale = nn.Parameter(torch.full((1, ch, 1), ls_init))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(F.gelu(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(F.gelu(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + self.scale * h


class DilatedResNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, ch=256, stem_ks=15, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 1, 2, 4),
                 dropout=0.1, head_dim=256, head_dropout=0.2):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, ch, stem_ks, padding=stem_ks // 2, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, 5, padding=2, bias=False),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[DilBlock(ch, d, 3, dropout) for d in dilations])
        self.final = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(ch), nn.GELU())
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2 * ch, head_dim, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(head_dropout),
            nn.Linear(head_dim, n_outputs))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.final(self.blocks(self.stem(x)))
        pooled = torch.cat([h.mean(dim=2), h.amax(dim=2)], dim=1)
        return self.head(pooled)


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return DilatedResNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), with one output per cell type."""
import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, reduction=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(oup, inp // reduction), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(inp // reduction, oup), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.fc(x.mean(dim=2))
        return x * y.unsqueeze(-1)


class EffBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, ks, resize_factor, activation):
        super().__init__()
        mid = in_ch * resize_factor
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, mid, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, mid, ks, groups=mid, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            SELayer(in_ch, mid, reduction=4),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, in_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class LocalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, ks, activation):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class ResidualConcat(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, fn):
        super().__init__()
        self.fn = fn

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([self.fn(x), x], dim=1)


class HistLegNet(nn.Module):
    """LegNet trunk with a histogram (HL-Gauss) output: per cell type a softmax over n_bins label
    bins on [lo, hi]. forward returns the expectation (B, n_outputs); in training the bin logits are
    left in torch._evoloop_hl for the loss."""
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=64, stem_ks=11, ef_ks=9,
                 ef_block_sizes=(128, 160, 192, 256), pool_sizes=(2, 2, 2, 2), resize_factor=4,
                 activation=nn.SiLU, n_bins=128, lo=-4.0, hi=12.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_outputs = n_outputs
        self.n_bins = n_bins
        self.lo = float(lo)
        self.hi = float(hi)
        self.stem = LocalBlock(in_ch, stem_ch, stem_ks, activation)
        blocks = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for pool, out_ch in zip(pool_sizes, ef_block_sizes):
            blocks.append(nn.Sequential(
                ResidualConcat(EffBlock(ch, ef_ks, resize_factor, activation)),
                LocalBlock(ch * 2, out_ch, ef_ks, activation),
                nn.MaxPool1d(pool) if pool != 1 else nn.Identity()))
            ch = out_ch
        self.main = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation())
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, ch * 2), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation(),
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, n_outputs * n_bins))
        width = (self.hi - self.lo) / n_bins
        centers = torch.linspace(self.lo + width / 2, self.hi - width / 2, n_bins)
        self.register_buffer("centers", centers)
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight.mul_(0.1)
            prior = -0.5 * ((centers - 0.5) / 1.2) ** 2
            last.bias.copy_(prior.repeat(n_outputs))

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.mapper(self.main(self.stem(x)))
        z = self.head(F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(x, 1).squeeze(-1)).float()
        z = z.view(-1, self.n_outputs, self.n_bins)
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_hl = (z, self.lo, self.hi)
        return (torch.softmax(z, dim=-1) * self.centers.float()).sum(-1)


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return HistLegNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), with one output per cell type."""
import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class CNBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, ks=9, expand=4, ls_init=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.dw = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding=ks // 2, groups=ch, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(ch)
        self.pw1 = nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * expand, 1)
        self.pw2 = nn.Conv1d(ch * expand, ch, 1)
        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(torch.full((1, ch, 1), ls_init))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.pw2(F.gelu(self.pw1(self.bn(self.dw(x)))))
        return x + self.gamma * h


class ConvNeXt1D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=128, stem_ks=15, widths=(128, 192, 256, 320),
                 depths=(2, 2, 3, 2), ks=9, head_dim=512, head_dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, stem_ch, stem_ks, padding=stem_ks // 2, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(stem_ch), nn.GELU())
        stages = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for i, (w, d) in enumerate(zip(widths, depths)):
            layers = []
            if i == 0:
                if w != ch:
                    layers.append(nn.Conv1d(ch, w, 1))
            else:
                layers += [nn.BatchNorm1d(ch), nn.Conv1d(ch, w, 2, stride=2)]
            layers += [CNBlock(w, ks) for _ in range(d)]
            stages.append(nn.Sequential(*layers))
            ch = w
        self.stages = nn.Sequential(*stages)
        self.final = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(ch), nn.GELU())
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * ch, head_dim, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(head_dim), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(head_dropout), nn.Linear(head_dim, n_outputs))

    def forward(self, x):
        W = x.shape[2]
        h = self.final(self.stages(self.stem(x)))
        L = h.shape[2]
        flank = max(0.0, (W - 200) / 2.0)
        a = int(round(flank / W * L))
        b = L - a
        if b <= a:
            a, b = 0, L
        ins = h[:, :, a:b].mean(dim=2)
        pooled = torch.cat([ins, h.mean(dim=2), h.amax(dim=2)], dim=1)
        return self.head(pooled)


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return ConvNeXt1D(n_outputs=n_outputs)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), with one output per cell type."""
import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, reduction=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(oup, inp // reduction), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(inp // reduction, oup), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.fc(x.mean(dim=2))
        return x * y.unsqueeze(-1)


class EffBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, ks, resize_factor, activation):
        super().__init__()
        mid = in_ch * resize_factor
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, mid, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, mid, ks, groups=mid, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            SELayer(in_ch, mid, reduction=4),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, in_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class LocalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, ks, activation):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class ResidualConcat(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, fn):
        super().__init__()
        self.fn = fn

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([self.fn(x), x], dim=1)


class AttnPool(nn.Module):
    """Softmax pooling over positions; scores = content score + learned positional bias.
    Both start at zero, so the module begins as plain average pooling."""
    def __init__(self, ch, max_len=32):
        super().__init__()
        self.score = nn.Conv1d(ch, 1, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.score.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.score.bias)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, max_len))

    def forward(self, x):
        L = x.shape[2]
        if L == self.pos.shape[2]:
            pos = self.pos
        else:
            pos = F.interpolate(self.pos, size=L, mode="linear", align_corners=False)
        s = self.score(x).float() + pos.float()
        w = torch.softmax(s, dim=2)
        return (x.float() * w).sum(dim=2)


class HistLegNet(nn.Module):
    """LegNet trunk with attention pooling and a histogram (HL-Gauss) output: per cell type a softmax

"""MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), with one output per cell type."""
import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class LocalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, ks, activation=nn.SiLU):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class LongConv(nn.Module):
    """Per-channel non-causal global convolution, computed by FFT in fp32. Explicit kernel of
    length 2L-1 centred at offset 0, damped by a learned per-channel exponential decay."""
    def __init__(self, d, max_len=128):
        super().__init__()
        self.max_len = max_len
        self.kernel = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(d, 2 * max_len - 1) * 0.02)
        self.log_rate = nn.Parameter(torch.linspace(-3.0, 0.0, d))
        self.D = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(d))
        self.register_buffer("offsets", torch.arange(-(max_len - 1), max_len).abs().float(), persistent=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        L = x.shape[-1]
        if L > self.max_len:
            raise ValueError("sequence longer than LongConv max_len")
        c = self.max_len - 1
        off = self.offsets[c - (L - 1): c + L]
        k = self.kernel[:, c - (L - 1): c + L].float() * torch.exp(
            -off[None, :] * torch.exp(self.log_rate.float())[:, None])
        n = 3 * L
        xf = x.float()
        y = torch.fft.irfft(torch.fft.rfft(xf, n=n) * torch.fft.rfft(k, n=n)[None], n=n)[..., L - 1:2 * L - 1]
        y = y + xf * self.D.float()[None, :, None]
        return y.to(x.dtype)


class HyenaBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, max_len):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.BatchNorm1d(d)
        self.inp = nn.Conv1d(d, 3 * d, 1)
        self.short = nn.Conv1d(3 * d, 3 * d, 3, padding=1, groups=3 * d)
        self.long = LongConv(d, max_len)
        self.out = nn.Conv1d(d, d, 1)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(d)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(d, 2 * d, 1), nn.SiLU(), nn.Conv1d(2 * d, d, 1))
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.out.weight.mul_(0.1)
            self.ffn[-1].weight.mul_(0.1)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.short(self.inp(self.norm(x)))
        v, g1, g2 = h.chunk(3, dim=1)
        u = self.long(v * torch.sigmoid(g1))
        u = u * F.silu(g2)
        x = x + self.out(u)
        x = x + self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
        return x


class HyenaNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, d=256, n_blocks=6, max_len=128):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            LocalBlock(in_ch, 128, 11),
            LocalBlock(128, 192, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
            LocalBlock(192, d, 9), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[HyenaBlock(d, max_len) for _ in range(n_blocks)])
        self.final = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(d), nn.SiLU())
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2 * d, 256), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(256, n_outputs))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.final(self.blocks(self.stem(x)))
        pooled = torch.cat([h.mean(dim=2), h.amax(dim=2)], dim=1)
        return self.head(pooled)


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return HyenaNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), with one output per cell type."""
import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class InceptionRes(nn.Module):
    """Residual block with parallel multi-width convolutions (3, 9, 19, dilated 5)."""
    def __init__(self, ch, activation=nn.SiLU):
        super().__init__()
        b = ch // 4
        self.pre = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(ch), activation())
        self.branches = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.Conv1d(ch, b, 3, padding="same", bias=False),
            nn.Conv1d(ch, b, 9, padding="same", bias=False),
            nn.Conv1d(ch, b, 19, padding="same", bias=False),
            nn.Conv1d(ch, ch - 3 * b, 5, padding="same", dilation=4, bias=False),
        ])
        self.mix = nn.Sequential(
            nn.BatchNorm1d(ch), activation(),
            nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch))
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.mix[-1].weight.mul_(0.5)
        self.act = activation()

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.pre(x)
        h = torch.cat([br(h) for br in self.branches], dim=1)
        return self.act(x + self.mix(h))


class InceptionHetero(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=128, widths=(128, 192, 256, 320),
                 blocks_per_stage=2, activation=nn.SiLU):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_outputs = n_outputs
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, stem_ch, 15, padding="same", bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(stem_ch), activation())
        layers = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for w in widths:
            if w != ch:
                layers += [nn.Conv1d(ch, w, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(w), activation()]
                ch = w
            for _ in range(blocks_per_stage):
                layers.append(InceptionRes(ch, activation))
            layers.append(nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.main = nn.Sequential(*layers)
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation())
        d = ch * 4
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), activation(),
            nn.Linear(512, n_outputs * 2))
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight[n_outputs:].mul_(0.1)
            last.bias[n_outputs:].fill_(math.log(0.3))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.mapper(self.main(self.stem(x)))
        g = torch.cat([h.mean(dim=2), h.amax(dim=2)], dim=1)
        z = self.head(g)
        mu = z[:, :self.n_outputs]
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_logvar = z[:, self.n_outputs:].float()
        return mu


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return InceptionHetero(n_outputs=n_outputs)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), with one output per cell type."""
import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, reduction=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(oup, inp // reduction), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(inp // reduction, oup), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.fc(x.mean(dim=2))
        return x * y.unsqueeze(-1)


class EffBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, ks, resize_factor, activation):
        super().__init__()
        mid = in_ch * resize_factor
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, mid, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, mid, ks, groups=mid, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            SELayer(in_ch, mid, reduction=4),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, in_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class LocalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, ks, activation):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class ResidualConcat(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, fn):
        super().__init__()
        self.fn = fn

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([self.fn(x), x], dim=1)


class HistLegNet(nn.Module):
    """LegNet trunk with a histogram (HL-Gauss) output: per cell type a softmax over n_bins label
    bins on [lo, hi]. forward returns the expectation (B, n_outputs); in training the bin logits are
    left in torch._evoloop_hl for the loss."""
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=64, stem_ks=11, ef_ks=9,
                 ef_block_sizes=(128, 160, 192, 256), pool_sizes=(2, 2, 2, 2), resize_factor=4,
                 activation=nn.SiLU, n_bins=128, lo=-4.0, hi=12.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_outputs = n_outputs
        self.n_bins = n_bins
        self.lo = float(lo)
        self.hi = float(hi)
        self.stem = LocalBlock(in_ch, stem_ch, stem_ks, activation)
        blocks = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for pool, out_ch in zip(pool_sizes, ef_block_sizes):
            blocks.append(nn.Sequential(
                ResidualConcat(EffBlock(ch, ef_ks, resize_factor, activation)),
                LocalBlock(ch * 2, out_ch, ef_ks, activation),
                nn.MaxPool1d(pool) if pool != 1 else nn.Identity()))
            ch = out_ch
        self.main = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation())
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, ch * 2), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation(),
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, n_outputs * n_bins))
        width = (self.hi - self.lo) / n_bins
        centers = torch.linspace(self.lo + width / 2, self.hi - width / 2, n_bins)
        self.register_buffer("centers", centers)
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight.mul_(0.1)
            prior = -0.5 * ((centers - 0.5) / 1.2) ** 2
            last.bias.copy_(prior.repeat(n_outputs))

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.mapper(self.main(self.stem(x)))
        z = self.head(F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(x, 1).squeeze(-1)).float()
        z = z.view(-1, self.n_outputs, self.n_bins)
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_hl = (z, self.lo, self.hi)
        return (torch.softmax(z, dim=-1) * self.centers.float()).sum(-1)


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return HistLegNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

            SELayer(in_ch, mid, reduction=4),

    def __init__(self, fn):
        super().__init__()
        self.fn = fn

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([self.fn(x), x], dim=1)


class MixHistLegNet(nn.Module):
    """LegNet trunk with an HL-Gauss histogram head and manifold mixup of the pooled embedding in
    training. forward returns the expectation (B, n_outputs). In training the bin logits are left in
    torch._evoloop_hl and the mixup (perm, lam) in torch._evoloop_mix for the loss."""
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=64, stem_ks=11, ef_ks=9,
                 ef_block_sizes=(128, 160, 192, 256), pool_sizes=(2, 2, 2, 2), resize_factor=4,
                 activation=nn.SiLU, n_bins=128, lo=-4.0, hi=12.0, mix_alpha=0.4, mix_prob=0.5):

        self.n_bins = n_bins
        self.lo = float(lo)
        self.hi = float(hi)
        self.mix_alpha = float(mix_alpha)
        self.mix_prob = float(mix_prob)
        self.stem = LocalBlock(in_ch, stem_ch, stem_ks, activation)
        blocks = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for pool, out_ch in zip(pool_sizes, ef_block_sizes):
            blocks.append(nn.Sequential(
                ResidualConcat(EffBlock(ch, ef_ks, resize_factor, activation)),
                LocalBlock(ch * 2, out_ch, ef_ks, activation),
                nn.MaxPool1d(pool) if pool != 1 else nn.Identity()))
            ch = out_ch
        self.main = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation())
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, ch * 2), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation(),
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, n_outputs * n_bins))
        width = (self.hi - self.lo) / n_bins
        centers = torch.linspace(self.lo + width / 2, self.hi - width / 2, n_bins)
        self.register_buffer("centers", centers)
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight.mul_(0.1)
            prior = -0.5 * ((centers - 0.5) / 1.2) ** 2
            last.bias.copy_(prior.repeat(n_outputs))

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.mapper(self.main(self.stem(x)))
        h = F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(x, 1).squeeze(-1)
        torch._evoloop_mix = None
        if self.training and self.mix_alpha > 0 and self.mix_prob > 0 and h.shape[0] > 1:
            b = h.shape[0]
            perm = torch.randperm(b, device=h.device)
            beta = torch.distributions.Beta(torch.tensor(self.mix_alpha), torch.tensor(self.mix_alpha))
            lam = beta.sample((b,)).to(h.device).float()
            lam = torch.maximum(lam, 1.0 - lam)
            use = torch.rand(b, device=h.device) < self.mix_prob
            lam = torch.where(use, lam, torch.ones_like(lam))
            lh = lam[:, None].to(h.dtype)
            h = lh * h + (1 - lh) * h[perm]
            torch._evoloop_mix = (perm, lam)
        z = self.head(h).float()
        z = z.view(-1, self.n_outputs, self.n_bins)
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_hl = (z, self.lo, self.hi)
        return (torch.softmax(z, dim=-1) * self.centers.float()).sum(-1)


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return MixHistLegNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, reduction=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(oup, inp // reduction), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(inp // reduction, oup), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.fc(x.mean(dim=2))
        return x * y.unsqueeze(-1)


class EffBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, ks, resize_factor, activation):
        super().__init__()
        mid = in_ch * resize_factor
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, mid, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, mid, ks, groups=mid, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            SELayer(in_ch, mid, reduction=4),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, in_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class LocalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, ks, activation):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class ResidualConcat(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, fn):
        super().__init__()
        self.fn = fn

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([self.fn(x), x], dim=1)


class HistLegNet(nn.Module):
    """LegNet trunk with a histogram (HL-Gauss) output: per cell type a softmax over n_bins label
    bins on [lo, hi]. forward returns the expectation (B, n_outputs); in training the bin logits are
    left in torch._evoloop_hl for the loss."""
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=64, stem_ks=11, ef_ks=9,
                 ef_block_sizes=(128, 160, 192, 256), pool_sizes=(2, 2, 2, 2), resize_factor=4,
                 activation=nn.SiLU, n_bins=128, lo=-4.0, hi=12.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_outputs = n_outputs
        self.n_bins = n_bins
        self.lo = float(lo)
        self.hi = float(hi)
        self.stem = LocalBlock(in_ch, stem_ch, stem_ks, activation)
        blocks = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for pool, out_ch in zip(pool_sizes, ef_block_sizes):
            blocks.append(nn.Sequential(
                ResidualConcat(EffBlock(ch, ef_ks, resize_factor, activation)),
                LocalBlock(ch * 2, out_ch, ef_ks, activation),
                nn.MaxPool1d(pool) if pool != 1 else nn.Identity()))
            ch = out_ch
        self.main = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation())
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, ch * 2), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation(),
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, n_outputs * n_bins))
        width = (self.hi - self.lo) / n_bins
        centers = torch.linspace(self.lo + width / 2, self.hi - width / 2, n_bins)
        self.register_buffer("centers", centers)
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight.mul_(0.1)
            prior = -0.5 * ((centers - 0.5) / 1.2) ** 2
            last.bias.copy_(prior.repeat(n_outputs))

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.mapper(self.main(self.stem(x)))
        z = self.head(F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(x, 1).squeeze(-1)).float()
        z = z.view(-1, self.n_outputs, self.n_bins)
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_hl = (z, self.lo, self.hi)
        return (torch.softmax(z, dim=-1) * self.centers.float()).sum(-1)


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return HistLegNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), with one output per cell type."""
import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class PreRes(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation residual block: BN-SiLU-conv-BN-SiLU-conv plus identity."""
    def __init__(self, ch, ks, dil=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.body = nn.Sequential(
            nn.BatchNorm1d(ch), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding="same", dilation=dil, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(ch), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False))

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.body(x)


class EncLevel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, ks):
        super().__init__()
        self.proj = nn.Identity() if cin == cout else nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(cout))
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(PreRes(cout, ks), PreRes(cout, ks))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.blocks(self.proj(x))


class DecLevel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cskip, ks):
        super().__init__()
        self.fuse = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(cin + cskip, cskip, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(cskip), nn.SiLU())
        self.block = PreRes(cskip, ks)

    def forward(self, x, skip):
        up = F.interpolate(x, size=skip.shape[-1], mode="nearest")
        return self.block(self.fuse(torch.cat([up, skip], dim=1)))


class UNetHist(nn.Module):
    """U-Net encoder-decoder over the sequence with a full-resolution readout and an HL-Gauss
    histogram head (per cell type a softmax over n_bins on [lo, hi]). forward returns the
    expectation (B, n_outputs); in training the bin logits are left in torch._evoloop_hl."""
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, chs=(128, 160, 192, 256), enc_ks=7, dec_ks=5,
                 n_bins=128, lo=-4.0, hi=12.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_outputs = n_outputs
        self.n_bins = n_bins
        self.lo = float(lo)
        self.hi = float(hi)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, chs[0], 11, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(chs[0]), nn.SiLU())
        self.enc = nn.ModuleList()
        cin = chs[0]
        for c in chs:
            self.enc.append(EncLevel(cin, c, enc_ks))
            cin = c
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool1d(2, ceil_mode=True)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(PreRes(chs[-1], 3, dil=2), PreRes(chs[-1], 3, dil=4),
                                        nn.BatchNorm1d(chs[-1]), nn.SiLU())
        self.dec = nn.ModuleList()
        cur = chs[-1]
        for c in reversed(chs):
            self.dec.append(DecLevel(cur, c, dec_ks))
            cur = c
        self.out_norm = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(chs[0]), nn.SiLU())
        feat = chs[-1] + 2 * chs[0]
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(feat, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(512, n_outputs * n_bins))
        width = (self.hi - self.lo) / n_bins
        centers = torch.linspace(self.lo + width / 2, self.hi - width / 2, n_bins)
        self.register_buffer("centers", centers)
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight.mul_(0.1)
            prior = -0.5 * ((centers - 0.5) / 1.2) ** 2
            last.bias.copy_(prior.repeat(n_outputs))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x)
        skips = []
        for level in self.enc:
            h = level(h)
            skips.append(h)
            h = self.pool(h)
        b = self.bottleneck(h)
        d = b
        for level, skip in zip(self.dec, reversed(skips)):
            d = level(d, skip)
        d = self.out_norm(d)
        feats = torch.cat([b.mean(dim=2), d.mean(dim=2), d.amax(dim=2)], dim=1)
        z = self.head(feats).float().view(-1, self.n_outputs, self.n_bins)
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_hl = (z, self.lo, self.hi)
        return (torch.softmax(z, dim=-1) * self.centers.float()).sum(-1)


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return UNetHist(n_outputs=n_outputs)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), with one output per cell type."""
import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class SE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, reduction=8):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(ch, ch // reduction), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(ch // reduction, ch), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        return x * self.fc(x.mean(dim=2)).unsqueeze(-1)


class PreActResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, ks):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.BatchNorm1d(ch), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(ch), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Conv1d(ch, ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False),
            SE(ch))

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.net(x)


class PositionalReadoutNet(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation SE ResNet trunk; readout = global average plus n_pos learned positional filters
    per channel (zero-initialised), then an HL-Gauss histogram head as in C45. forward returns the
    expectation (B, n_outputs); in training the bin logits are left in torch._evoloop_hl."""
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, stem_ch=192, stage_ch=(192, 256, 320, 384), stage_ks=(9, 9, 5, 5),
                 blocks_per_stage=2, n_pos=4, max_len=15, hidden=512, n_bins=128, lo=-4.0, hi=12.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_outputs = n_outputs
        self.n_bins = n_bins
        self.lo = float(lo)
        self.hi = float(hi)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, stem_ch, 15, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(stem_ch), nn.SiLU())
        layers = []
        cur = stem_ch
        for ch, ks in zip(stage_ch, stage_ks):
            if ch != cur:
                layers += [nn.BatchNorm1d(cur), nn.SiLU(), nn.Conv1d(cur, ch, 1, bias=False)]
                cur = ch
            for _ in range(blocks_per_stage):
                layers.append(PreActResBlock(ch, ks))
            layers.append(nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.trunk = nn.Sequential(*layers)
        self.final = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(cur), nn.SiLU())
        self.n_pos = n_pos
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(n_pos, max_len))
        feat = cur * (1 + n_pos)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(feat, hidden), nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden, n_outputs * n_bins))
        width = (self.hi - self.lo) / n_bins
        centers = torch.linspace(self.lo + width / 2, self.hi - width / 2, n_bins)
        self.register_buffer("centers", centers)
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight.mul_(0.1)
            prior = -0.5 * ((centers - 0.5) / 1.2) ** 2
            last.bias.copy_(prior.repeat(n_outputs))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.final(self.trunk(self.stem(x)))
        L = h.shape[2]
        pos = self.pos
        if pos.shape[1] != L:
            pos = F.interpolate(pos.unsqueeze(0), size=L, mode="linear", align_corners=False).squeeze(0)
        g = h.mean(dim=2)
        p = torch.einsum("bcl,rl->bcr", h.float(), pos.float()).reshape(h.shape[0], -1)
        f = torch.cat([g.float(), p], dim=1).to(h.dtype)
        z = self.head(f).float()
        z = z.view(-1, self.n_outputs, self.n_bins)
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_hl = (z, self.lo, self.hi)
        return (torch.softmax(z, dim=-1) * self.centers.float()).sum(-1)


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return PositionalReadoutNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

"""MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), with one output per cell type."""
import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class KmerStem(nn.Module):
    """Input stem: one-hot convolution plus a learned embedding of the centred k-mer at each position.
    The embedding is a lookup table, so each k-mer gets its own vector (non-additive within the word).
    Positions whose k-mer touches a blanked (all-zero, N) base use a zero padding vector."""
    def __init__(self, out_ch, k=6, conv_ks=11, activation=nn.SiLU):
        super().__init__()
        self.k = k
        self.n_kmers = 4 ** k
        self.conv = nn.Conv1d(4, out_ch, conv_ks, padding="same", bias=False)
        self.emb = nn.Embedding(self.n_kmers + 1, out_ch, padding_idx=self.n_kmers)
        with torch.no_grad():
            nn.init.normal_(self.emb.weight, std=0.05)
            self.emb.weight[self.n_kmers].zero_()
        self.norm = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch)
        self.act = activation()
        self.register_buffer("pows", 4 ** torch.arange(k - 1, -1, -1, dtype=torch.long))

    def forward(self, x):
        k = self.k
        xf = x.float()
        codes = xf.argmax(dim=1)
        valid = (xf.sum(dim=1) > 0.5).float()
        left = (k - 1) // 2
        right = k - 1 - left
        c = F.pad(codes, (left, right))
        v = F.pad(valid, (left, right))
        cw = c.unfold(1, k, 1)
        vw = v.unfold(1, k, 1).amin(dim=-1) > 0.5
        idx = (cw * self.pows).sum(dim=-1)
        idx = torch.where(vw, idx, torch.full_like(idx, self.n_kmers))
        e = self.emb(idx).transpose(1, 2)
        h = self.conv(x)
        h = h + e.to(h.dtype)
        return self.act(self.norm(h))


class SqueezeExcite(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, reduction=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(oup, inp // reduction), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(inp // reduction, oup), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        return x * self.fc(x.mean(dim=2)).unsqueeze(-1)


class InvertedBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, ks, expand, activation):
        super().__init__()
        mid = in_ch * expand
        self.body = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, mid, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, mid, ks, groups=mid, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            SqueezeExcite(in_ch, mid, reduction=4),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, in_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([self.body(x), x], dim=1)


class ConvBNAct(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, ks, activation):
        super().__init__()
        self.body = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.body(x)


class KmerHistNet(nn.Module):
    """k-mer embedding stem, LegNet-style trunk, HL-Gauss histogram head (per cell type a softmax
    over n_bins on [lo, hi]). forward returns the expectation; in training the logits go to
    torch._evoloop_hl for the loss."""
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, stem_ch=64, k=6, stem_ks=11, ks=9,
                 widths=(128, 160, 192, 256), pools=(2, 2, 2, 2), expand=4,
                 activation=nn.SiLU, n_bins=128, lo=-4.0, hi=12.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_outputs = n_outputs
        self.n_bins = n_bins
        self.lo = float(lo)
        self.hi = float(hi)
        self.stem = KmerStem(stem_ch, k=k, conv_ks=stem_ks, activation=activation)
        stages = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for pool, out_ch in zip(pools, widths):
            stages.append(nn.Sequential(
                InvertedBlock(ch, ks, expand, activation),
                ConvBNAct(ch * 2, out_ch, ks, activation),
                nn.MaxPool1d(pool) if pool != 1 else nn.Identity()))
            ch = out_ch
        self.trunk = nn.Sequential(*stages)
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation())
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, ch * 2), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation(),
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, n_outputs * n_bins))
        bw = (self.hi - self.lo) / n_bins
        centers = torch.linspace(self.lo + bw / 2, self.hi - bw / 2, n_bins)
        self.register_buffer("centers", centers)
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight.mul_(0.1)
            prior = -0.5 * ((centers - 0.5) / 1.2) ** 2
            last.bias.copy_(prior.repeat(n_outputs))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.mapper(self.trunk(self.stem(x)))
        z = self.head(F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(h, 1).squeeze(-1)).float()
        z = z.view(-1, self.n_outputs, self.n_bins)
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_hl = (z, self.lo, self.hi)
        return (torch.softmax(z, dim=-1) * self.centers.float()).sum(-1)


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return KmerHistNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)

"""MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), with one output per cell type."""
import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class SE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, reduction=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(ch, max(8, ch // reduction)), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(max(8, ch // reduction), ch), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        return x * self.fc(x.mean(dim=2)).unsqueeze(-1)


class DenseLayer(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation bottleneck: BN-SiLU-1x1(4g)-BN-SiLU-conv ks(g). Output is concatenated to input."""
    def __init__(self, in_ch, growth, ks, bottleneck=4):
        super().__init__()
        mid = growth * bottleneck
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, mid, 1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, growth, ks, padding="same", bias=False))

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([x, self.net(x)], dim=1)


class Transition(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, pool):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, 1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), nn.SiLU(),
            SE(out_ch),
            nn.MaxPool1d(pool) if pool > 1 else nn.Identity())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class HistDenseNet(nn.Module):
    """DenseNet1d trunk with an HL-Gauss histogram output (as in C57's HistLegNet): per cell type a
    softmax over n_bins label bins on [lo, hi]. forward returns the expectation (B, n_outputs); in
    training the bin logits are left in torch._evoloop_hl for the loss."""
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=64, stem_ks=11, ks=9, growth=48,
                 layers_per_stage=(4, 4, 4, 4), trans_ch=(128, 160, 192, 256), pools=(2, 2, 2, 2),
                 n_bins=128, lo=-4.0, hi=12.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_outputs = n_outputs
        self.n_bins = n_bins
        self.lo = float(lo)
        self.hi = float(hi)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, stem_ch, stem_ks, padding="same", bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(stem_ch), nn.SiLU())
        stages = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for n_layers, out_ch, pool in zip(layers_per_stage, trans_ch, pools):
            mods = []
            for _ in range(n_layers):
                mods.append(DenseLayer(ch, growth, ks))
                ch += growth
            mods.append(Transition(ch, out_ch, pool))
            ch = out_ch
            stages.append(nn.Sequential(*mods))
        self.main = nn.Sequential(*stages)
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), nn.SiLU())
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, ch * 2), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, n_outputs * n_bins))
        width = (self.hi - self.lo) / n_bins
        centers = torch.linspace(self.lo + width / 2, self.hi - width / 2, n_bins)
        self.register_buffer("centers", centers)
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight.mul_(0.1)
            prior = -0.5 * ((centers - 0.5) / 1.2) ** 2
            last.bias.copy_(prior.repeat(n_outputs))

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.mapper(self.main(self.stem(x)))
        z = self.head(F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(x, 1).squeeze(-1)).float()
        z = z.view(-1, self.n_outputs, self.n_bins)
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_hl = (z, self.lo, self.hi)
        return (torch.softmax(z, dim=-1) * self.centers.float()).sum(-1)


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return HistDenseNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, reduction=4):
        super().__init__()

            nn.Linear(oup, inp // reduction), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(inp // reduction, oup), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.fc(x.mean(dim=2))
        return x * y.unsqueeze(-1)


class EffBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, ks, resize_factor, activation):
        super().__init__()
        mid = in_ch * resize_factor
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, mid, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, mid, ks, groups=mid, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            SELayer(in_ch, mid, reduction=4),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, in_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class LocalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, ks, activation):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class ResidualConcat(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, fn):
        super().__init__()
        self.fn = fn

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([self.fn(x), x], dim=1)


class MixHistLegNet(nn.Module):
    """LegNet trunk (blocks_per_stage EffBlock+LocalBlock units per stage) with an HL-Gauss histogram
    head and manifold mixup of the pooled embedding in training. forward returns the expectation
    (B, n_outputs). In training the bin logits are left in torch._evoloop_hl and the mixup
    (perm, lam) in torch._evoloop_mix for the loss."""
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=64, stem_ks=11, ef_ks=9,
                 ef_block_sizes=(128, 160, 192, 256), pool_sizes=(2, 2, 2, 2), resize_factor=4,
                 activation=nn.SiLU, n_bins=128, lo=-4.0, hi=12.0, mix_alpha=0.4, mix_prob=0.5,
                 blocks_per_stage=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_outputs = n_outputs
        self.n_bins = n_bins
        self.lo = float(lo)
        self.hi = float(hi)
        self.mix_alpha = float(mix_alpha)
        self.mix_prob = float(mix_prob)
        self.stem = LocalBlock(in_ch, stem_ch, stem_ks, activation)
        blocks = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for pool, out_ch in zip(pool_sizes, ef_block_sizes):
            layers = []
            for j in range(blocks_per_stage):
                target = out_ch if j == blocks_per_stage - 1 else ch
                layers.append(ResidualConcat(EffBlock(ch, ef_ks, resize_factor, activation)))
                layers.append(LocalBlock(ch * 2, target, ef_ks, activation))
                ch = target
            layers.append(nn.MaxPool1d(pool) if pool != 1 else nn.Identity())
            blocks.append(nn.Sequential(*layers))
            ch = out_ch
        self.main = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation())
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, ch * 2), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation(),
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, n_outputs * n_bins))
        width = (self.hi - self.lo) / n_bins
        centers = torch.linspace(self.lo + width / 2, self.hi - width / 2, n_bins)
        self.register_buffer("centers", centers)
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight.mul_(0.1)
            prior = -0.5 * ((centers - 0.5) / 1.2) ** 2
            last.bias.copy_(prior.repeat(n_outputs))

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.mapper(self.main(self.stem(x)))
        h = F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(x, 1).squeeze(-1)
        torch._evoloop_mix = None
        if self.training and self.mix_alpha > 0 and self.mix_prob > 0 and h.shape[0] > 1:
            b = h.shape[0]
            perm = torch.randperm(b, device=h.device)
            beta = torch.distributions.Beta(torch.tensor(self.mix_alpha), torch.tensor(self.mix_alpha))
            lam = beta.sample((b,)).to(h.device).float()
            lam = torch.maximum(lam, 1.0 - lam)
            use = torch.rand(b, device=h.device) < self.mix_prob
            lam = torch.where(use, lam, torch.ones_like(lam))
            lh = lam[:, None].to(h.dtype)
            h = lh * h + (1 - lh) * h[perm]
            torch._evoloop_mix = (perm, lam)
        z = self.head(h).float()
        z = z.view(-1, self.n_outputs, self.n_bins)
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_hl = (z, self.lo, self.hi)
        return (torch.softmax(z, dim=-1) * self.centers.float()).sum(-1)


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return MixHistLegNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

    def __init__(self, n_cells, ch):

    """One LegNet with shared early stages; the deep stages, mapper and head are run once per cell
    type on the same weights, each followed by a per-cell FiLM, so deep features can specialise by
    cell type. HL-Gauss output: per cell a softmax over n_bins; forward returns the expectation and
    in training leaves the (B, n_cells, n_bins) logits in torch._evoloop_hl."""
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=64, stem_ks=11, ef_ks=9,
                 ef_block_sizes=(128, 160, 192, 256), pool_sizes=(2, 2, 2, 2), resize_factor=4,
                 n_shared=2, activation=nn.SiLU, n_bins=128, lo=-4.0, hi=12.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_outputs = n_outputs
        self.n_bins = n_bins
        self.lo = float(lo)
        self.hi = float(hi)
        self.stem = LocalBlock(in_ch, stem_ch, stem_ks, activation)
        stages = []
        ch = stem_ch
        chans = []
        for pool, out_ch in zip(pool_sizes, ef_block_sizes):
            stages.append(nn.Sequential(
                ResidualConcat(EffBlock(ch, ef_ks, resize_factor, activation)),
                LocalBlock(ch * 2, out_ch, ef_ks, activation),
                nn.MaxPool1d(pool) if pool != 1 else nn.Identity()))
            ch = out_ch
            chans.append(out_ch)
        self.shared = nn.Sequential(*stages[:n_shared])
        self.cond = nn.ModuleList(stages[n_shared:])
        self.films = nn.ModuleList([CellFiLM(n_outputs, c) for c in chans[n_shared:]])
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation())
        self.film_map = CellFiLM(n_outputs, ch * 2)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, ch * 2), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation(),
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, n_bins))
        width = (self.hi - self.lo) / n_bins
        centers = torch.linspace(self.lo + width / 2, self.hi - width / 2, n_bins)
        self.register_buffer("centers", centers)
        prior = -0.5 * ((centers - 0.5) / 1.2) ** 2
        self.cell_bias = nn.Parameter(prior[None, :].repeat(n_outputs, 1).clone())
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight.mul_(0.1)
            last.bias.zero_()

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.shared(self.stem(x))
        b, c, l = h.shape
        n = self.n_outputs
        h = h.unsqueeze(0).expand(n, b, c, l).reshape(n * b, c, l)
        cell = torch.arange(n, device=h.device).repeat_interleave(b)
        for stage, film in zip(self.cond, self.films):
            h = film(stage(h), cell)
        h = self.film_map(self.mapper(h), cell)
        z = self.head(F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(h, 1).squeeze(-1)).float()
        z = z.view(n, b, self.n_bins).transpose(0, 1) + self.cell_bias.float()[None]
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_hl = (z, self.lo, self.hi)
        return (torch.softmax(z, dim=-1) * self.centers.float()).sum(-1)


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return CellFiLMLegNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
import math
import torch.nn.functional as F


class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, reduction=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(oup, inp // reduction), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(inp // reduction, oup), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.fc(x.mean(dim=2))
        return x * y.unsqueeze(-1)


class EffBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, ks, resize_factor, activation):
        super().__init__()
        mid = in_ch * resize_factor
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, mid, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, mid, ks, groups=mid, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            SELayer(in_ch, mid, reduction=4),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, in_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class LocalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, ks, activation):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class ResidualConcat(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, fn):
        super().__init__()
        self.fn = fn

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([self.fn(x), x], dim=1)


class MixHeteroLegNet(nn.Module):
    """LegNet trunk with a mean + log-variance head per cell type and manifold mixup of the pooled
    embedding in training. forward returns the means (B, n_outputs); in training the log-variances
    are left in torch._evoloop_logvar and the mixup (perm, lam) in torch._evoloop_mix for the loss."""
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=64, stem_ks=11, ef_ks=9,
                 ef_block_sizes=(128, 160, 192, 256), pool_sizes=(2, 2, 2, 2), resize_factor=4,
                 activation=nn.SiLU, mix_alpha=0.4, mix_prob=0.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_outputs = n_outputs
        self.mix_alpha = float(mix_alpha)
        self.mix_prob = float(mix_prob)
        self.stem = LocalBlock(in_ch, stem_ch, stem_ks, activation)
        blocks = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for pool, out_ch in zip(pool_sizes, ef_block_sizes):
            blocks.append(nn.Sequential(
                ResidualConcat(EffBlock(ch, ef_ks, resize_factor, activation)),
                LocalBlock(ch * 2, out_ch, ef_ks, activation),
                nn.MaxPool1d(pool) if pool != 1 else nn.Identity()))
            ch = out_ch
        self.main = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation())
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, ch * 2), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation(),
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, n_outputs * 2))
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight[n_outputs:].mul_(0.1)
            last.bias[n_outputs:].fill_(math.log(0.3))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.mapper(self.main(self.stem(x)))
        h = F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(h, 1).squeeze(-1)
        torch._evoloop_mix = None
        if self.training and self.mix_alpha > 0 and self.mix_prob > 0 and h.shape[0] > 1:
            b = h.shape[0]
            perm = torch.randperm(b, device=h.device)
            beta = torch.distributions.Beta(torch.tensor(self.mix_alpha), torch.tensor(self.mix_alpha))
            lam = beta.sample((b,)).to(h.device).float()
            lam = torch.maximum(lam, 1.0 - lam)
            use = torch.rand(b, device=h.device) < self.mix_prob
            lam = torch.where(use, lam, torch.ones_like(lam))
            lh = lam[:, None].to(h.dtype)
            h = lh * h + (1 - lh) * h[perm]
            torch._evoloop_mix = (perm, lam)
        z = self.head(h)
        mu = z[:, :self.n_outputs]
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_logvar = z[:, self.n_outputs:].float()
        return mu


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return MixHeteroLegNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

            torch._evoloop_mix = (perm, lam)

        if self.training:

        return (torch.softmax(z, dim=-1) * self.centers.float()).sum(-1)

class BottleneckAttn(nn.Module):
    """One pre-norm transformer layer over the (B, C, L) bottleneck positions with a learned
    positional embedding. Output projections start at zero, so the layer begins as the identity."""
    def __init__(self, ch, heads=4, ff_mult=2, max_len=32, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, max_len, ch))
        nn.init.normal_(self.pos, std=0.02)
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(ch)
        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(ch, heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)

            self.attn.out_proj.bias.zero_()

            self.ff[-1].bias.zero_()

        t = x.transpose(1, 2)

            pos = F.interpolate(self.pos.transpose(1, 2), size=L, mode="linear", align_corners=False).transpose(1, 2)

    """One pre-norm transformer layer over the (B, C, L) bottleneck positions with a learned
    positional embedding. Output projections start at zero, so the layer begins as the identity."""
    def __init__(self, ch, heads=4, ff_mult=2, max_len=32, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, max_len, ch))
        nn.init.normal_(self.pos, std=0.02)
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(ch)
        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(ch, heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)

            nn.Linear(ch * 2, ch * 2), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation(),
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, n_outputs * n_bins))
        width = (self.hi - self.lo) / n_bins
        centers = torch.linspace(self.lo + width / 2, self.hi - width / 2, n_bins)
        self.register_buffer("centers", centers)
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight.mul_(0.1)
            prior = -0.5 * ((centers - 0.5) / 1.2) ** 2
            last.bias.copy_(prior.repeat(n_outputs))

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.mapper(self.main(self.stem(x)))
        h = F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(x, 1).squeeze(-1)
        torch._evoloop_mix = None
        if self.training and self.mix_alpha > 0 and self.mix_prob > 0 and h.shape[0] > 1:
            b = h.shape[0]
            perm = torch.randperm(b, device=h.device)
            beta = torch.distributions.Beta(torch.tensor(self.mix_alpha), torch.tensor(self.mix_alpha))
            lam = beta.sample((b,)).to(h.device).float()
            lam = torch.maximum(lam, 1.0 - lam)
            use = torch.rand(b, device=h.device) < self.mix_prob
            lam = torch.where(use, lam, torch.ones_like(lam))
            lh = lam[:, None].to(h.dtype)
            h = lh * h + (1 - lh) * h[perm]
            torch._evoloop_mix = (perm, lam)
        z = self.head(h).float()
        z = z.view(-1, self.n_outputs, self.n_bins)
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_hl = (z, self.lo, self.hi)
        return (torch.softmax(z, dim=-1) * self.centers.float()).sum(-1)

"""MPRA-LegNet (Penzar et al. 2023; human_legnet), with one output per cell type."""
import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START name=model kind=structure
import math
import torch.nn.functional as F


class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, reduction=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(oup, inp // reduction), nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(inp // reduction, oup), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.fc(x.mean(dim=2))
        return x * y.unsqueeze(-1)


class EffBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, ks, resize_factor, activation):
        super().__init__()
        mid = in_ch * resize_factor
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, mid, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, mid, ks, groups=mid, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(mid), activation(),
            SELayer(in_ch, mid, reduction=4),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, in_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(in_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class LocalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, ks, activation):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(in_ch, out_ch, ks, padding="same", bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(out_ch), activation())

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.block(x)


class ResidualConcat(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, fn):
        super().__init__()
        self.fn = fn

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.cat([self.fn(x), x], dim=1)


class CellFiLM(nn.Module):
    """Per-cell-type feature-wise affine modulation; zero-initialised, so it starts as identity."""
    def __init__(self, n_cells, ch):
        super().__init__()
        self.emb = nn.Embedding(n_cells, 2 * ch)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.emb.weight)

    def forward(self, h, cell):
        g, b = self.emb(cell).chunk(2, dim=-1)
        return h * (1.0 + g[:, :, None].to(h.dtype)) + b[:, :, None].to(h.dtype)


class MixHeteroFiLMLegNet(nn.Module):
    """One LegNet with shared early stages; the deep stages, mapper and head run once per cell type
    on the same weights, each followed by a per-cell FiLM. The head gives a mean and a log-variance per
    cell. Manifold mixup of the pooled embedding in training uses the same (perm, lam) for all cells.
    forward returns the means (B, n_outputs); in training the log-variances are left in
    torch._evoloop_logvar and the mixup (perm, lam) in torch._evoloop_mix for the loss."""
    def __init__(self, n_outputs=3, in_ch=4, stem_ch=64, stem_ks=11, ef_ks=9,
                 ef_block_sizes=(128, 160, 192, 256), pool_sizes=(2, 2, 2, 2), resize_factor=4,
                 n_shared=2, activation=nn.SiLU, mix_alpha=0.4, mix_prob=0.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_outputs = n_outputs
        self.mix_alpha = float(mix_alpha)
        self.mix_prob = float(mix_prob)
        self.stem = LocalBlock(in_ch, stem_ch, stem_ks, activation)
        stages = []
        chans = []
        ch = stem_ch
        for pool, out_ch in zip(pool_sizes, ef_block_sizes):
            stages.append(nn.Sequential(
                ResidualConcat(EffBlock(ch, ef_ks, resize_factor, activation)),
                LocalBlock(ch * 2, out_ch, ef_ks, activation),
                nn.MaxPool1d(pool) if pool != 1 else nn.Identity()))
            ch = out_ch
            chans.append(out_ch)
        self.shared = nn.Sequential(*stages[:n_shared])
        self.cond = nn.ModuleList(stages[n_shared:])
        self.films = nn.ModuleList([CellFiLM(n_outputs, c) for c in chans[n_shared:]])
        self.mapper = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(ch, ch * 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation())
        self.film_map = CellFiLM(n_outputs, ch * 2)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, ch * 2), nn.BatchNorm1d(ch * 2), activation(),
            nn.Linear(ch * 2, 2))
        cb = torch.zeros(n_outputs, 2)
        cb[:, 1] = math.log(0.3)
        self.cell_bias = nn.Parameter(cb)
        with torch.no_grad():
            last = self.head[-1]
            last.weight[1:].mul_(0.1)
            last.bias.zero_()

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.shared(self.stem(x))
        b, c, l = h.shape
        n = self.n_outputs
        h = h.unsqueeze(0).expand(n, b, c, l).reshape(n * b, c, l)
        cell = torch.arange(n, device=h.device).repeat_interleave(b)
        for stage, film in zip(self.cond, self.films):
            h = film(stage(h), cell)
        h = self.film_map(self.mapper(h), cell)
        h = F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(h, 1).squeeze(-1)
        torch._evoloop_mix = None
        if self.training and self.mix_alpha > 0 and self.mix_prob > 0 and b > 1:
            perm = torch.randperm(b, device=h.device)
            beta = torch.distributions.Beta(torch.tensor(self.mix_alpha), torch.tensor(self.mix_alpha))
            lam = beta.sample((b,)).to(h.device).float()
            lam = torch.maximum(lam, 1.0 - lam)
            use = torch.rand(b, device=h.device) < self.mix_prob
            lam = torch.where(use, lam, torch.ones_like(lam))
            hv = h.view(n, b, -1)
            lh = lam[None, :, None].to(hv.dtype)
            hv = lh * hv + (1 - lh) * hv[:, perm]
            h = hv.reshape(n * b, -1)
            torch._evoloop_mix = (perm, lam)
        z = self.head(h).float()
        z = z.view(n, b, 2).transpose(0, 1) + self.cell_bias.float()[None]
        mu = z[..., 0]
        if self.training:
            torch._evoloop_logvar = z[..., 1].contiguous()
        return mu


def build_model(n_outputs=3):
    return MixHeteroFiLMLegNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

        self.branches = nn.ModuleList([CellBranch(ch * 2, branch_hidden, activation) for _ in range(n_outputs)])

    return MixHeteroBranchLegNet(n_outputs=n_outputs)
